name: Pearlantis City
chat: Welcome to Pearlantis. Please don’t tap the glass.
The bubble trams go round and round. That’s the whole idea.
We used to be the richest city in the Hollow Earth. Now we’re the deepest.

people.name: Curator Nacre
script: You came down the lift? Then you’ve seen the pipes. Everyone up there thinks they carry water. #l:c88a
They carry gold. Ours. Vinylla’s pressing plant has been pumping the city’s vaults dry for a year to pay for her tour. #l:dd60
The ledger is in the Exchange, if you can stomach the numbers. Somebody ought to send her the bill. #l:ba93
We sank because we wouldn’t spend. Now someone else is spending it for us. There’s a lesson in that, but I’m too cross to learn it. #l:0deb
The mirrors bring the Inner Sun down to us. Nobody can own the sun, not even in Pearlantis. Especially not in Pearlantis. #l:9e5f
